scope: Read-only knowledge qualification review of corrected initial cash-purchase boundary. No substantive implementation, knowledge proposition, approval metadata or source document changes by this reviewer.
disposition: R6 resolved within existing governed purchase method; unsupported gift/nonexchange measurements are not enabled.
accounting_challenge: Paying conveyancing fees is not evidence of purchase consideration to acquire a property. A gift with zero donor consideration cannot use purchased-property cost authority to recognize only fees as property cost. Missing acquisition nature, explicit nonexchange/asset exchange, true/missing gifted qualification, and zero/fee-only purchase price now block before recognition.
reviewed_correction: Initial event requires acquisition_nature cash_purchase, property gifted false, and strictly positive independently sourced summed purchase_price separate from direct_transaction fees; eligible total cost remains tied to gross property cost, cash payment and source snapshot. Positive source-backed ordinary purchase remains supported.

knowledge_basis.qualification: Purchased-property recognition/cost and original-owner acquisition-scope qualifications support this restriction. They do not establish donated-property, nonexchange or industry-specific gift measurement.
knowledge_basis.source_assurance: All96claims retain existing independently reviewed model-derived status and open direct-source audit. No new source verification or paragraph citation asserted for gift accounting.
